Privacy policy — Whose Stuff? Character Quiz
Mirheydar Badirov, trading as Duck Nap Games, is the publisher of this game and the controller of personal information handled by the publisher. Contact:

The game saves progress, coin balance, used clues, and preferences on your device so that you can play offline. Optional Google Play Games features support sign-in, achievements, leaderboards, and progress backup. When connected, our game service processes account and installation identifiers, gameplay and reward operations, wallet transactions, purchase verification records, and advertising events to synchronize the game, deliver purchases and rewards, measure monetization, and prevent duplicate or fraudulent claims. Clearing app storage removes the local save; recovery depends on the connected account and available backups. Google Play Games profile and activity visibility are also controlled through your Google settings.

The game uses Google AdMob mediation, including Unity Ads, to provide optional rewarded advertisements. Choosing to watch an advertisement can earn in-game coins. Google’s User Messaging Platform collects and manages applicable privacy choices for the configured advertising partners.

Google’s advertising SDK can collect your IP address (which can indicate approximate location), device and account identifiers such as the advertising ID and app set ID where available, app and advertisement interactions, and diagnostic information. Google uses this information for advertising, measurement, and fraud prevention. The game does not request GPS location, contacts, or camera access.
. Unity Ads may process device and advertising identifiers, IP address, ad interactions, and diagnostic information for ad delivery, measurement, and fraud prevention under its
Game Player and App User Privacy Policy
. Advertising partners and their purposes, where applicable, are described in the consent message.

Where consent is required, applicable choices are requested before ads are requested. You can revisit the game’s privacy choices through Settings when that option is available. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing. Your device’s advertising settings may also let you reset or delete its advertising identifier. Declining personalized advertising does not necessarily stop all processing needed to deliver or secure other advertisements.

If you email us, we receive your email address, your message, and any information you choose to include. We use this to answer you, resolve problems, and handle privacy requests. Please avoid sending sensitive information or unnecessary information about children.

In the European Economic Area and UK, we rely on consent for advertising-related device access and processing where required. We use our legitimate interest in responding to requests and maintaining a secure service to handle support correspondence, and comply with legal obligations where applicable. Advertising partners’ legal bases and choices are described in the consent interface and their notices.

Advertising data is handled by Google and relevant advertising partners. Support correspondence is handled using Gmail. We may disclose information when necessary to comply with law or protect legal rights. We do not sell support correspondence.

Local saves remain under your control on your device. We keep support correspondence while needed to resolve your request and any related dispute or legal obligation, then delete it when no longer needed. Google determines retention of information it handles as described in its privacy notices; we cannot delete that information directly.
Google states that its mobile ads SDK encrypts data in transit using TLS. We restrict access to our support mailbox. No system can guarantee complete security.
Google and our hosting provider may process data outside your country, including outside the EEA. Their privacy notices describe applicable safeguards and transfer arrangements. See
Request data deletion: steps, data covered, and retention details

Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, or portability of your information, object to processing, and withdraw consent. Email us to exercise rights concerning information we hold. Requests about information Google holds may need to be directed to Google. We may need proportionate information to verify a request.
You may complain to your local data protection authority, including Poland’s
. We do not use support information to make solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects.

Whose Stuff? Character Quiz is intended for teens and adults who enjoy recognizing familiar fictional characters. It is not designed for or directed at children under 13. A store content rating describes the suitability of the game’s content and does not replace this intended-audience statement.

We do not ask players to submit names, email addresses, or other contact information inside the game. If a parent or guardian believes a child under 13 has provided personal information through the game or support, please contact us. We will investigate and delete information within our control where appropriate, and help direct requests concerning information held by our service providers.
Older minors should review this policy with a parent or guardian. Requirements for consent and advertising can differ by country and age; this audience statement does not override those requirements.

Request data deletion — Whose Stuff? Character Quiz
Published by Mirheydar Badirov, trading as Duck Nap Games.

State whether you want your Whose Stuff game-service account and associated data deleted, or only specific data. For a linked game account, include your Play Games profile name and, if available, a purchase order ID or approximate date of play so we can locate the record. We will arrange proportionate verification before deleting an account. For support correspondence, write from the same email address and identify the relevant message or approximate date.
We will review your request and explain what we can delete, any necessary verification, and any retention exceptions. You do not need to reinstall the game or create an account.
Please do not send passwords, identity documents, or sensitive information unless we explain why specific verification is necessary.

You can request deletion of your Whose Stuff game-service account, linked installation identifiers, synchronized gameplay and wallet data, and associated advertising-event records that we control. You can also request deletion of support emails, your contact email address, message contents, and attachments. Deleting this game-service account does not delete your Google account or Play Games profile. It can permanently remove synchronized progress and coin balances; tell us if you only want a particular category of data deleted.

We keep account and gameplay data while needed to provide the connected service. After a verified deletion request, we delete or de-identify the associated information within our control, except records needed for legal obligations, purchase/refund handling, fraud prevention, or an unresolved dispute. We keep support correspondence while needed to resolve your request and any related dispute or legal obligation, then delete it when no longer needed. We do not apply an additional routine retention period after fulfilling a deletion request. If specific information must be kept for a legal obligation or unresolved dispute, we will explain the information retained, the reason, and the applicable period or the criteria determining that period. It is kept only as long as that reason applies.
Progress and settings stored on your phone

To delete local progress, coin balance, used clues, and sound and animation settings, open Android Settings → Apps → Whose Stuff? Character Quiz → Storage → Clear data (or Clear storage). This resets your progress. Device or cloud backups are managed through your device's backup settings; clearing local storage does not necessarily delete a backup.
Google Play Games and advertising-provider data
You can remove game data held by Google Play Games through its profile and game-data settings. For Unity Ads data, use the privacy controls and request information in
Unity’s Game Player and App User Privacy Policy
. We can help identify the appropriate provider but cannot delete an independent provider’s records ourselves.

Google AdMob may handle IP addresses, approximate location, device and account identifiers, advertisement interactions, and diagnostics. We cannot directly delete information held by Google or promise that it is deleted within 90 days. Google's retention and deletion practices are described in its
for information it holds. You can also email us for help identifying the appropriate request route.

Where available, Settings in the game lets you revisit advertising privacy choices. Android's advertising privacy settings let you reset or delete your advertising ID. These controls do not by themselves guarantee deletion of previously collected advertising data.
Official Privacy Policy — Farm Pals Forever — contact Duck Nap Games for privacy questions.

Your farm is saved on your device. The game has no player accounts, advertising, or third-party analytics SDKs. Optional purchases use Google Play, and optional reminders are scheduled on your device. If you email us, we receive the information you choose to send.

Mirheydar Badirov, trading as Duck Nap Games, publishes Farm Pals Forever and is responsible for personal information handled by the publisher. This policy applies to Farm Pals Forever and its privacy-policy webpage. Our other games may have different policies.

The game stores your farm progress, crops, coins, inventory, deliveries, friendships, purchase entitlements, and preferences on your device. Your practice farm, language choice, sound settings, and reminder settings are also stored locally. The game reads device language and basic screen/platform information to choose the language and display the interface.

We do not operate a game server or a player-account system that receives these saves. Farm Pals Forever does not include advertising, an advertising identifier integration, social sign-in, third-party analytics, or a developer-operated crash-reporting service. It does not ask you to provide a name or email address to play. The game does not access your contacts, precise location, camera, microphone, or phone-call information.

Your operating system may back up or restore app data according to your device and Google-account settings. Such backup is controlled by the platform; it is not a cloud-save service operated by Duck Nap Games.

If you enable reminders and grant Android notification permission, the game schedules local notifications for game events such as ready crops or deliveries. Reminder timing and notification content are processed and stored on your device. We do not use a remote push-notification service or receive notification tokens. You can turn reminders off in the game or revoke notification permission in Android settings.

The Android game uses Google Play Billing for optional one-time purchases. Google processes the purchase, payment details, Google-account information, and information needed to operate its payment services under its
. We do not receive your payment-card details.

The app communicates with Google Play to obtain product prices, make and acknowledge purchases, and restore owned content. Google Play returns product and transaction information, which can include product identifiers, purchase tokens or receipts, order identifiers, purchase status, and acknowledgement status. The app uses this information to unlock and restore purchases and saves ownership and related game rewards locally. The current game does not send these transactions to a Duck Nap Games server.

Google may provide us with order records and aggregated sales, installation, quality, and performance reports through Play Console. We use these to administer the game, handle purchase questions, and understand its operation. Google determines its own collection and retention practices for its services.

The Google Play Billing library also sends technical billing diagnostics to Google using its data-transport component. These reports include billing API events and errors, app and library version information, Android and device characteristics, network and locale information, timing information, and a randomly generated billing-session identifier. They help Google operate and diagnose the billing service. These transmissions use HTTPS. Duck Nap Games does not receive the raw diagnostic event stream or use it for advertising or player profiling. Google handles this information under its Privacy Policy.

If you email us, we receive your email address, your message, and any information or attachments you choose to send, such as an order number or a screenshot. We use this information to answer your request, troubleshoot problems, and resolve purchase or privacy questions. Please do not send passwords, payment-card details, or information unrelated to your request.

We use information to provide game features, fulfil purchases, respond to support requests, and meet applicable legal obligations. Where applicable data-protection law requires a legal basis, these purposes are based on providing the service you request, our legitimate interests in operating and supporting it, or a legal obligation. Device notification permission is optional.

We do not sell or rent personal information. Information may be processed by Google for Google Play and email services, or by GitHub when you visit this website. We may disclose information where legally required or necessary to address fraud, security, or legal claims. These providers may process information in countries other than your own under their privacy policies.

Local game data uses app storage provided by your device. We do not transmit farm saves to our servers. The policy webpage uses HTTPS, and purchases are handled through Google Play. We limit access to support correspondence and use account security protections. No storage or transmission method can be guaranteed completely secure.
Local saves remain until you reset relevant progress, clear the app's storage in Android settings, or uninstall the game, subject to any operating-system backup or later restore. The in-game

option resets the selected farm's progress while preserving purchases; it does not erase every saved setting or remove Google Play's purchase records. To remove all local app data, use Android's clear-storage option. Device backups can be managed through your device or Google-account settings.

We keep support correspondence for as long as reasonably needed to resolve the request, maintain relevant support records, and comply with applicable legal obligations. Purchase records accessible through Google may need to be retained for accounting, fraud prevention, or legal purposes. You can ask us to delete information within our control by emailing us. We will delete it unless a lawful reason requires retention, and explain any such limitation. We cannot directly delete data held independently by Google or GitHub; their policies explain the available controls.

You can play without creating a player account, decline optional purchases, disable reminders, and clear local data. Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, object to processing, or obtain a copy of personal information we hold about you. Contact us to make a request. We may need limited information to verify that the request concerns you. You may also have the right to complain to your local data-protection authority.

The game does not require players to submit personal information or create accounts. A parent or guardian should supervise optional purchases and any support messages sent by a child. If you believe a child has sent personal information to us, contact us so we can review and delete information within our control where appropriate.

. Opening external links from the game or this page loads the relevant provider's service, which may receive normal connection information and apply its own privacy policy.
We may update this policy when the game or our practices change. We will update the effective date on this page and provide additional notice where required.
